title: Represent per-row composition coverage without converting missing data to zero
finding: On inspection, E390-02A is fully implemented and passing CI; the DAG node status was stale (NOT_IMPLEMENTED) because the status update was never committed after the M2A implementation landed. The implementation is complete across the Fortran backend (compute), the EOSData dataclass (storage/round-trip), and the Python API (read/write).

fortran_backend.role: Computes row_status, per-species *_present flags, and C3/C4_applicable per row while parsing eos.compo (Npairs/Nquad/Iphase aware). Emits the values to the internal CSV with lowercase headers (row_status, yn_present, ..., c3_applicable, c4_applicable).

fields: Yn_present, Yp_present, Ye_present, Ymu_present, Abar_present, Zbar_present, Yh_present (bool)
dataclass.round_trip: write_internal_directory serializes all 9 mask arrays to eos_data.csv with safe defaults for legacy-constructed objects; from_internal_directory reads them back via the lowercase Fortran headers. copy() propagates all mask fields.

python_api.role: read_compose delegates to run_native('read', ...) -> EOSData.from_internal_directory; write_compose delegates to data.write_internal_directory -> run_native('write', ...). Mask fields flow through both directions.

1_Npairs0_Nquad0_preserves_Iphase_record.evidence: Npairs=0/Nquad=0 rows keep Iphase, row_status=PARTIAL(1), all *_present=False, C3/C4 not applicable. composition_available=False (not measured zero).

2_every_particle_id_and_group_has_explic.evidence: Yn_present, Yp_present, Ye_present, Ymu_present, Abar_present, Zbar_present, Yh_present are per-row bool arrays (a written zero is True; a missing entry is False).

3_C3_and_C4_applicability_independent_an.evidence: C3 requires Yn+Yp+Yh complete (baryon); C4 requires Yp+Abar+Zbar+Yh+Ye+Ymu complete (charge). Computed independently per row: a row with Yn missing has C4_applicable=True but C3_applicable=False.

4_GM_GM1_missing_outer_core_species_not_.evidence: GM_GM1 outer-crust phase-only rows (Npairs=0) produce row_status=PARTIAL, not FAIL; no NativeExecutionError raised.

5_masks_survive_transformations_and_comp.evidence: write_compose -> read_compose round trip preserves row_status, all *_present, C3/C4_applicable bit-for-bit (against a fully-CHECKED source). Fail-closed: write_compose raises if composition_available without eos.compo sidecar.

6_no_SPG_GPPVA_final_tuple_remapping.evidence: A Yh=1.0 value (C6B-ambiguous) is preserved byte-for-byte (within float64 round-trip tolerance 1e-10); no remap to Y_I/X_h/Ye/aggregate. row_status reflects the per-row range check, not a guess.

row_status_ontology.0_NOT_AVAILABLE: eos.compo absent, or row not present in file
row_status_ontology.1_PARTIAL: row present but composition incomplete (some required species/group missing); C3 or C4 not applicable
row_status_ontology.2_CHECKED: row present with complete baryon + charge inventory; both C3 and C4 applicable and closure satisfied
row_status_ontology.3_FAIL: row present but a physical range check failed (e.g. Yn<0)

c3_c4_definitions.C3_applicable: per-row: complete baryon inventory present (Yn, Yp, Yh) so Yn+Yp+Yh=1 can be checked
c3_c4_definitions.C4_applicable: per-row: complete charge inventory present (Yp, Abar>0, Zbar, Yh, Ye, Ymu) so Yp+(Z/A)Yh=Ye+Ymu can be checked
c3_c4_definitions.independence: C3 and C4 are computed independently per row; a row can have C3_applicable=True and C4_applicable=False (or vice versa) depending on which inventory is complete

downstream_impact.E390_02: row-level duplicate-row guard + provider-semantics-B now have per-row masks available
downstream_impact.E390_03_plus: M3-M6 predecessors can use row_status to decide per-row closure applicability instead of a global composition_available flag
downstream_impact.E390_10: the generic CompOSE reader (E390-10) inherits the same mask fields via EOSData

next_node_recommendation: E390-02A is resolved. The next action per DAG next_actions[1] is E390-02C (move find_density_gap selection from Python into Fortran; quarantine Python/SciPy prototypes).
